# Lab 23.16: Investigate with Log Analytics (SQL)

## What We Are Going to Do
Upgrade a log bucket to Log Analytics and use SQL to answer investigation questions.

## Steps

1. **Upgrade the `_Default` bucket.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud logging buckets update _Default --location=global --enable-analytics</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The upgrade cannot be undone, and only new logs are included at first.

2. **Open Log Analytics.** Go to **Logging → Log Analytics**. Choose the `_Default` bucket's `_AllLogs` view.

3. **Who called which methods today?**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  proto_payload.audit_log.authentication_info.principal_email AS who,
  proto_payload.audit_log.method_name AS action,
  COUNT(*) AS calls
FROM `YOUR_PROJECT_ID.global._Default._AllLogs`
WHERE timestamp &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND proto_payload.audit_log.method_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY who, action
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 20</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Who changed IAM policies?**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT timestamp,
  proto_payload.audit_log.authentication_info.principal_email AS who,
  proto_payload.audit_log.resource_name AS resource
FROM `YOUR_PROJECT_ID.global._Default._AllLogs`
WHERE proto_payload.audit_log.method_name LIKE "%SetIamPolicy%"
ORDER BY timestamp DESC</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Which errors happen most?**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT log_name, severity, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM `YOUR_PROJECT_ID.global._Default._AllLogs`
WHERE severity IN ("ERROR", "CRITICAL")
GROUP BY log_name, severity
ORDER BY n DESC</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Create a linked BigQuery dataset** to join logs with other data, without copying it.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud logging links create lab_link --bucket=_Default --location=global</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Query language | Standard SQL |
| Data copy | None needed |
| Linked dataset | Query logs from BigQuery |
